comparison.mode1: Ordinary both-ready RR plus proven tripleP10, with fourth P in another group. Out-of-range Q1 exactly falls back to dualP13.
comparison.mode2: Identical ordinary RR plus centered fourP8/high5, grant-controlled repair and final canonicalization.
comparison.schedule: Both contexts start together after both native source tiles are loaded. Disjoint resource requests may proceed together; conflicts alternate RR. No seq or phase-offset comparison mode.
comparison.scope: Same two contexts, 416bit z service, state union, producer/consumer ALUs and native output function. Mode4 adds one control bit; adapted RTL supports all four modes and original64 controls are rerun there.
comparison.mode3: Faithful RR+fourP13: borrow the existing consumer wide sum ALUs with consumer priority.
comparison.mode4: One targeted adaptation: group RR between consumer and borrowing producers. Both contexts retain ordinary RR.

shared_top.producer_ALU: Exactly eight32bit carry chains; formats full32,2x13,3x10,4x8,4x5. Context operands are selected before these chains. Proof, Q1, repair, normalization and Q2 bind here.
shared_top.producer_MAC: Exactly eight signed19x13 multiplier expressions, with coefficient/scalar selected before multiplication; no multiplier or carry chain in rr_context.
shared_top.weights: One Q1 array8x864x3=2592B and one Q2 array8x96x16=1536B, with a common granted owner/address. No copies in the contexts.
shared_top.proof_bounds: One positive/negative pair per rank,2x8x13bit=26B. The common ALU performs864 proof updates during the paid cold Q1 configuration beats; range_ok broadcasts to both contexts. Warm skips proof and same resident parameters.
shared_top.atomic_requests: Mode1/2 ZADD and all BASE_MAC/repair/normalize require z+producer32 atomically. Mode3/4 ZADD requires z+wide64 atomically. ZREAD remains one granted416bit transaction. No new memory address or simultaneous z access.
shared_top.consumer: Exactly one complete consumer with eight32x32 multipliers and its existing eight64bit main sum chains moved to one top-level wide_phase_alu. Consumer has operand/result buses and no second main sum expression. FP32-to-J20 and final RNE/saturation logic are unchanged, including their original bounded increment logic.
shared_top.wide64: Eight64bit main sum carry chains, with carry cuts at13/26/39 for four signed13 fields. One operand mux selects consumer or one granted context before these chains; no copied wide ALU. Results broadcast but only granted client may commit.

two_private_contexts_common.source: 2x1536x10bit=3840B; one granted source read globally, four private local read muxes per160bit C1 window.
two_private_contexts_common.z: 2x8banksx10rowsx52bit=1040B; each context520B and416bit vector interface, but one global z-class grant per cycle. One grant-gated read expression/common address per bank; complete52bit word writes.
two_private_contexts_common.psum: 2x8x480x32bit=30720B, each context full materialization and480 read/480 write transactions per tile; one global psum-class grant per cycle.
two_private_contexts_common.qblock: 2x8x8x16bit=256B, filled from the unique top weight read.
two_private_contexts_common.z_hold: 2x8x52bit=104B, equal in both modes; old208bit-port D3 had smaller holds and is not a same-area denominator.
two_private_contexts_common.correction: 2x8lanesx4P x2bit=16B. No separate high array: high5 shares each13bit z field with low8.
two_private_contexts_common.remaining_state: Each context keeps k_live864bit, v_live96bit, position_live320bit, q_hold24bit, source masks40bit, pending40bit, rank/block masks, eight32bit acc,256bit output holding, origin/counters/FSM. All declarations identical between modes.
two_private_contexts_common.extra_logic: Per-context overflow sign tests, correction select, packing muxes and an OR request decision. Field popcount is diagnostic and does not determine grants or repair-needed. No private data adder/multiplier; local gather/metadata/priority logic remains real extra hardware.

accounting.shared_ALU_grants: proof + Q2 MAC + repair + normalization + (Q1 if mode1/2 else0)
accounting.conflict_cycles: core_arbitration_stalls = context conflict_cycles + borrow_consumer_stalls. wide_conflict_cycles counts contested clocks; borrow_consumer_stalls counts denied producer requests. consumer_wide_waits is separately paid by consumer_cycles.
accounting.window: consumer_cycles+tiles+floor(tiles/2); launch=ceil(tiles/2). Sum of context cycles is overlapping occupancy and must not be added to this total.
accounting.shared_wide_grants: consumer_add_issues + borrow_grants; borrow_grants=Q1_issues only in mode3/4

candidate_semantics.centered: z=signed8(low)+256*signed5(high). Signed overflow gives high delta=-1/+1; pending Q1 work does not advance past an unserved repair.
candidate_semantics.repair: Low write, then granted416bit REPAIR_READ and granted4x5 ALU/write. At least2 extra service cycles per repair transaction; actual RR waiting is separately counted.
candidate_semantics.canonicalization: After all Q1, ten rows each use granted read plus granted4x5 ALU/write to compute high'=high-low[7]. At least20 service cycles per tile, plus measured RR waiting. Q2 directly reads normal signed13 concatenations.
candidate_semantics.exact_domain: All binary source inputs and signed3 Q1 with K864 have partial z in[-3456,2592], fitting centered high5. tripleP10 is used only when actual loaded Q1 positive/negative bounds prove[-512,511].
candidate_semantics.borrow: All four canonical signed13 fields update through the same existing consumer64 ALU; no modular repair or final normalization is required.

limits: Verilator4.028 component cycles only. The original64 native interval has zero consumer/borrow conflict, so a separate asymmetric adjacent pair tests that condition. No EDA, physical port mapping, Fmax, energy, full-frame, training, production changes or commit.
